mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations, resulting in negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST above 1.45 million, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals a broad-based demand surge that increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal fails to generate a positive Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that justify continued monetary tightening, leading to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0%, or the interaction signal fails to produce a positive Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market momentum that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp, or the interaction signal fails to generate a positive Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals a durable demand expansion that increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal fails to generate a positive Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
